title: How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks

scenes.narration: Tech news you need to know. How NVIDIA Open Source Tools Are Helping Researchers Build Next-Generation 6G Networks.
A year ago, NVIDIA open sourced its Aerial wireless software, joining Sionna and a broader suite of open source tools for accelerating next-generation 6G network development.
